saw_lines: Organic juice buyers check the label for sugar and certification, then restock the same bottle once they trust it.
So a new buyer who cannot tell how the juice arrives will skip it, and the ad has seconds to answer that.
Your site explains how it arrives, yet 0 of 8 ads show it. Film the box arriving at the door in one video ad and lead with it.
ads_1: Video ads showing the box arriving and the first sip, delivery answered up front.
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, X and YouTube
